scope: Fourteen transport, environment and agriculture laws only
weightBasis: ALL weights are authored design choices grounded in cited positions, NOT empirical estimates or sampled probabilities. They are relevance strengths, not vote or support shares.
sourcePolicy: Sources were actually read; broad positions are not mislabeled as endorsements of an exact law. Conditional directions specify affected actors and terms. Statements in party platforms are positions, not independently verified factual estimates.
canonicalPolicy: Question and principle keys validated against existing catalog/inventory. No saved organization IDs or institutional memberships are invented. The current law-interest-group reader creates groups from actual exposure; this payload does not bypass it.
